document.abstract: The SMPTE ST 2081 suite of documents defines the mapping of various source image formats onto a single-link, dual-link and quad-link serial digital interface operating at a nominal rate of 6 Gb/s. This informative “overview” describes the documents in the SMPTE ST 2081 suite. The SMPTE ST 2081 series specify a common virtual interface that is carried on both electrical and optical physical interfaces which are also defined in the document suite.
